description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommand' that implements the 'Command' interface. It provides common functionality for command objects, including handling command type, headers, JSON serialization, and validation logic. It is part of a package related to signals and commands within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for command implementations, providing shared functionality such as JSON serialization, headers validation, and equality checks.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the command type as its manifest representation.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with this command.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to a JSON object according to the specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to append command-specific payload data to the JSON builder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the command's headers and type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this command and another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to assist with proper equality checks in subclassing scenarios.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
